# Rival Flow

Rival Flow is a workflow automation platform for finance teams.

## What is finance workflow automation?
Finance workflow automation routes invoices, approvals and month-end tasks through rules instead of email, so nothing waits in an inbox.

## Customers
Used by 120 finance teams.
